newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ACIL in US$30.9 mln deal with Bollore.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ACIL in US$30.9 mln deal with Bollore.

text.p: Investment group Australian Consolidated Investments Ltd (ACIL) said on Thursday it would pay US$30.856 million to Groupe Bollore Technologies as part of a shipping joint venture between the two companies.
ACIL is controlled by Brierley Investments Ltd.
ACIL said as part of the deal it would acquire the trans-Tasman operations of the Union Shipping Group of New Zealand (USG), which is a unit of Brierley, for US$18 million.
The Sydney-based ACIL said it would then sell half of the USG assets to Bollore and purchase a half share in Bollore's Australia New Zealand Direct Line.
It said the joint venture would provide services between Australia, New Zealand and the West Coast of the United States.
The joint venture deal was subject to regulatory approvals in Australia and New Zealand, ACIL said.
